objective: Validate AXIGNAL's B2G procurement narrative, paid packaging and premium price bands, then implement a disabled-by-default seven-day controlled trial with server-side entitlements, cost ceilings and explicit expiry.
outcome: Qualified B2G design partners can purchase a clearly bounded professional workflow, while an approved private trial cohort can complete one evidence-linked value loop without silent billing, source-right bypass, tenant leakage, unbounded processing or premium-positioning ambiguity.

skills.activation_reason: Design and test B2G price bands, value metrics and rejection conditions.
Express every plan and trial limit as a versioned server-side capability grant.
Predeclare paid, trial and premium-perception experiments with guardrails.
Measure qualified activation, value-loop completion, paid conversion and payback.
Implement explicit plan selection and prevent silent trial conversion or uncontrolled overage.
Govern trial identity, tenant-private data, retention and deletion.
Review tenant isolation, abuse controls, file boundaries and administrative suspension.
Keep hypotheses, private trial evidence and public commercial states distinct.

external: Customer-facing terms, privacy and retention review

allowed_scope: Professional, Team and Enterprise pricing experiments within Contract 28 bands
Seven-day private controlled trial behind feature flag
Hard ResearchRun, dossier, document, page, export and cost limits
Qualified activation, conversion, margin, abuse and support telemetry
prohibited_scope: Public unrestricted trial before gate acceptance
API or bulk source redistribution in trial
Predictive win, margin, eligibility or legal scores
Pricing represented as validated before paid evidence

acceptance_evidence.description: Qualified B2G buyers correctly understand the category, plan differences and evidence boundary without perceiving the product as a commodity alert service.
Independent paid Design Partner or equivalent annual-contract evidence tests at least two materially different offers.
Versioned entitlement and trial-state models map every marketed capability to server-side enforcement.
E2E tests prove activation, hard limits, expiry, read-only transition, no auto-charge, upgrade, cancellation and deletion.
Trial tenancy, organisation verification, abuse controls, file processing, export and operator suspension pass review.
Activation, value-loop completion, paid intent, variable cost, support burden, abuse and gross-margin evidence are denominator-safe and reproducible.

traces: deletion request to terminal purge state

rollback.strategy: Disable trial and new-plan feature flags, stop new activations, preserve existing paid agreements under their versioned entitlements, and migrate active trial workspaces to declared read-only or deletion states.
rollback.kill_switch: Separate commercial, trial, source and payment kill switches must prevent new execution or charging independently.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The commercial system funds the selected public-procurement discovery workflow.
Paid and trial access never removes evidence, provenance or claim-state requirements.
Plans grant capacity across the same InvestigationContext rather than fragmented feature pages.
Acquisition behaviour is analysed separately from procurement truth.
Locale, currency, language and original evidence requirements remain explicit.
Premium value is tied to persistent evidence workflow, not generic AI access.
The trial prepares professional investigation without executing bids or guaranteeing outcomes.
Security, privacy, rights and billing are critical acceptance gates.
Feature flags, hard stops, no auto-charge and explicit deletion provide bounded rollback.
The task follows rather than bypasses the TED end-to-end product-admission gate.
